transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because of a situation that's been going on. 

For months now, I’ve just been noticing this... pattern. My sister’s appointments keep getting moved around, and bills keep showing up wrong. People suddenly "forget" to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me they’re just administrative mistakes, but... I know they're not. I know they’re deliberately keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of decisions.
Are you completely certain that people are deliberately keeping information from you?

...Yes. I am. 

It's just... it happens too often. The appointments, the bills... people don't just make that many mistakes. I know they're doing it to keep me out of the decisions. 

I don't really want to argue about it. That's just what's happening.
During this time, have you felt unusually energetic?
No... not really. Just my normal self, I guess.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
Is it possible that there could be another explanation for these mistakes besides people deliberately trying to keep you out?

No... I really don't think so. I know everyone keeps saying they're just mistakes, but... I've been seeing the exact same pattern for months now. 

My sister's appointments get moved around... the bills show up wrong... people just suddenly forget to call me back. It's too much to be an accident. I just know they're keeping things from me. They want to push me out of the decisions... that's what's happening.
Before these past few months, have you generally tended to mistrust other people’s motives?
No... I wouldn't say that. I usually trust people just fine. I've always gotten along with everyone at the office and... everywhere else. It's just what's happening right now.
Have other people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?
No... nobody's said anything like that. I speak perfectly fine. My thoughts are clear.
Has this been going on for at least three months?

Yes... it's been longer than that. Probably about eleven months. It started when... well, when my sister's health suddenly got worse. I had to step in and start coordinating all her care then, and... yeah, that's when it began.
Have you had the feeling that someone is controlling your thoughts?
No. No, I don't... I don't feel like that. My thoughts are my own.
